thread:
alexander: Heads up — onboarding AstraX-8B int4 (per-channel) hit a weird regression on the multi-turn summarization eval suite.
maya: :thinking_face: what kind of regression? quality, perf, or instability?
alexander: quality. ROUGE-L down ~6pts, and a lot more generic/hallucinated completions in 4+ turn dialogs. Latency/cost look fine.
tomas: Did you compare fp16 vs int4 outputs on the same prompt set? any diffs in logits or attention patterns?
alexander: yep. FP16 matches baseline. Int4 shows strange attention heatmaps — some heads zeroing out after turn 2. KV cache looks shifted.
jenny: Shifted how? off by one token or by embedding axis?
alexander: appears like a token-index shift in the kv-cache read-out. When we dump k/v for token ids around a sentinel token, the values are rotated by +1 in token index for half the heads.
maya: That smells like tokenizer/BOS handling or vocab reindex on conversion. Did the model conversion script add/remove special tokens or change IDs?
tomas: Also check rotary application. If embeddings got remapped, a rotary phase index mismatch could make heads alternate behaviour (even vs odd heads).
alexander: Conversion command we used:
```
python convert_hf.py --src hf/astrax-8b --dst rdinfer/astrax-8b-int4 --quant method=perchannel bits=4
```
We used the standard hf->rd conversion, plus a small token remap file (from an upstream fork) to keep compatibility with our tokenizer.
jenny: Can you paste the small remap? maybe the BOS got mapped to 0 instead of 1.
alexander: remap snippet: `{"<bos>":0, "<pad>":1}`. Oops that was applied after export.
maya: There you go. Upstream expects BOS=1 in positional logic? Some rotary impls assume a non-zero start index for phase math.
tomas: If BOS moved to 0, then the rotary rotation alignment for heads that use even/odd interleaving may shift by one, causing cancellation in some heads — consistent with "half the heads" problem.
jenny: Quick repro: run short two-turn dialog with debug KV indices. I can run on a dev GPU.
alexander: repro script: `python run_infer.py --model rdinfer/astrax-8b-int4 --prompt-file tests/2turn.json --dump-kv --heads 0-15`
deploy-bot: scheduled job rdinfer/bug-repro-3344556677 started on instance gpu-dev-06
maya: If that's the case, fix options: 1) remap tokens back to original IDs; 2) apply a one-token shift in KV indexing during export; 3) patch rotary phase offset in runtime to compensate.
tomas: I prefer fixing at conversion time to keep runtime simple. We can detect special token placements and rewrite the token map.
jenny: I'll try quick patch: swap BOS/PAD IDs back to upstream and re-run quant conversion.
alexander: Thanks. If that fixes the KV alignment, we'll run the eval suite overnight.
maya: Also add a unit test to the conversion tool to assert that special token IDs match expected values from model config. Saved us time.
alexander: Agreed. Filing follow-up for conversion tests and eval rerun. Thanks everyone :)
